objects.name: Ransomware attack on Molars Dental Practice (Kenya)
objects.description: Ransomware group ransomhub claimed attack and leaked 19 GB of data. Molars is a leading dental clinic network based in Nairobi, providing specialized care ranging from orthodontics to dental surgery for local and international clientele.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on General Authority for Government Services (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. GAGS is the regulatory authority for government services in Egypt. It oversees tender procedures, state inventory management, and disposal of public assets.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Pick n Pay (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group apt73 claimed attack and leaked data. Pick n Pay Group Ltd is the second largest food retailer in South Africa.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on SEOCOM Marrakech (Morocco)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. SEOCOM is a Moroccan agency providing SEO (Search Engine Optimization), advertising campaign management (SEA), and web development services for local and international companies.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on INTELS Nigeria Limited (Nigeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group ransomhub claimed attack and exfiltrated approximately 1.5 TB of sensitive data. Intels is a pillar of the Nigerian economy, managing 90% of offshore oil exploration support activities.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Sharm Reef Hotel (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group spacebears claimed attack and leaked data. Sharm Reef Hotel is a 4-star resort located on the Um El Sid plateau in Sharm El Sheikh, Egypt.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Misr Technology Services (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. Misr Technology Services (MTS) is the Egyptian government entity responsible for developing and managing the national trade facilitation platform, including the Nafeza system.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Barika University Center (Algeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. The Barika University Center (Ahmed Ben Abderrezak El Hamouda) is a higher education hub located in the wilaya of Batna, offering programs in technological sciences, law, and humanities.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Inaya Clinic (Algeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group spacebears claimed attack and leaked data. Inaya Clinic is a multidisciplinary medical facility in Algeria, renowned for its centers of excellence in cardiology, cardiovascular surgery, and obstetrics-gynecology.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Lower Niger River Basin Development Authority (Nigeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group GDLockerSec claimed attack and leaked data. LNRBDA is a strategic agency under the supervision of the Nigerian Federal Ministry of Water Resources. It manages dam projects, irrigation, drinking water supply, and rural development.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Sidi Mohamed Ben Abdellah University (Morocco)
objects.description: Ransomware group GDLockerSec claimed attack and leaked data. USMBA is a multidisciplinary university comprising numerous institutions (Faculties of Medicine, Science, Letters, ENCG, ENSA, etc.).

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Achievers Journal of Scientific Research (Nigeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. AJSR is a multidisciplinary peer-reviewed journal that publishes original research in the fields of applied sciences, engineering, and technology.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on FGSE, Cairo University (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group GDLockerSec claimed attack and leaked data. The FGSE (Faculty of Graduate Studies for Education) is one of the oldest and most respected research institutions in Egypt.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on QED (Uganda)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. QED is a leading Ugandan firm specializing in Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning (MEL). It supports projects funded by international organizations in the health, education, and governance sectors.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Workers (Zambia)
objects.description: Ransomware group babuk2 claimed attack and leaked data. Zambian recruitment and temporary work services company.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Zetech University (Kenya)
objects.description: Ransomware group babuk2 claimed attack and leaked data. Zetech University is a leading higher education institution in Kenya.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Xlab Group (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group fog claimed attack and leaked data. Xlab Group is an Egyptian company specializing in digital marketing solutions, software development, brand strategy consulting, and digital transformation for Middle Eastern companies.
labels: Business Services / Technology Consulting (IT & Digital Solutions)

objects.name: Ransomware attack on ASK Gras Savoye (Morocco)
objects.description: Ransomware group ransomhub claimed attack and leaked data. ASK Gras Savoye is one of the leading insurance brokers in Morocco.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on South African Weather Service (SAWS) (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group ransomhub claimed attack and leaked data. The South African Weather Service (SAWS) is South Africa's national meteorological service, providing weather forecasts and warnings.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Government Services Portal (Zambia)
objects.description: Ransomware group flocker claimed attack and leaked 1.2 GB of data. The services.gov.zm portal is the central platform of the Zambian government (Smart Zambia Institute). It brings together over 322 online services, ranging from visa and permit applications to tax and administrative services for citizens and businesses.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Brolly (Ghana)
objects.description: Ransomware group killsec claimed attack and leaked data. Brolly is a Ghanaian insurtech startup offering flexible and affordable car insurance solutions (pay-as-you-go model). It allows drivers to spread their insurance payments weekly or monthly via a digital platform.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Paratus (Namibia)
objects.description: Ransomware group akira claimed attack and leaked data. Paratus is a Pan-African telecommunications operator, investing in network infrastructure across Africa.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on SPEED Co (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group hunter claimed attack and exfiltrated 444.8 GB of data (285,891 files). SPEED Co (Speed Ahmed Hassan) is one of the largest logistics and distribution service providers in Egypt. The company manages storage and transportation of Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) for major multinationals and local brands.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Shaghalni (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group killsec claimed attack and leaked data. Shaghalni is one of the leading recruitment platforms in Egypt, specializing in connecting job seekers (notably technical and blue-collar profiles) with companies.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on IT-IQ Botswana (Botswana)
objects.description: Ransomware group play claimed attack and leaked data. IT-IQ Botswana is one of the leading providers of IT solutions and certified training (Microsoft, Cisco, VMware) in Botswana.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Workforce Group (Nigeria)
objects.description: Ransomware group killsec claimed attack and leaked data. Workforce Group is a Nigerian educational services and human resources management company.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on LINKGROUP (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group arcusmedia claimed attack and leaked data. LINKGROUP is a South African IT consulting and telecom services company.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on synaptic.co.tz (Tanzania)
objects.description: Ransomware group arcusmedia claimed attack and leaked data. Tanzanian IT consulting company.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on ACDC Express (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group lynx claimed attack and leaked data. ACDC Dynamics is a major South African manufacturer, importer, and distributor of electrical components, tools, and safety equipment.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on ISEE (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group funksec claimed attack and leaked data. The International School of Elite Education (ISEE) is a prestigious private school located in Cairo.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on MISR AL MAHABA HOSPITAL (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group nightspire claimed attack and leaked data. Misr Al Mahaba Hospital is a significant private healthcare center in Cairo.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on INI Investments (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group nightspire claimed attack and exfiltrated 400 GB of data. INI Investments is a diversified Egyptian holding company. It invests in strategic sectors such as real estate, energy, technology, and financial services.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on moh.gov.rw (Rwanda)
objects.description: Ransomware group babuk2 claimed attack and leaked data. Ministry of Health of Rwanda.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on IACC Holdings (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group dragonforce claimed attack and exfiltrated 27.75 GB of data. IACC Holdings is an Egyptian private investment holding company focused on maritime transport and logistics.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Cell C (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group ransomhouse claimed attack and leaked data. Cell C is a South African telecommunications operator, one of the country's leading mobile service providers.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on International Business Service (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group crypto24 claimed attack and leaked data. International Business Service (IBS) is one of the largest outsourcing service providers in Egypt. The company specializes in human resources management, mass recruitment, payroll outsourcing, and maintenance/logistics services for large companies and multinationals.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on CNSS (Morocco)
objects.description: Group Jabaroot DZ claimed attack and leaked data. CNSS is the National Social Security Fund of Morocco.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Ministry of Industry and Commerce (Morocco)
objects.description: Group Jabaroot DZ claimed attack and leaked data. The MIEPEEC is the Moroccan government body responsible for steering industrial strategy, promoting investment, and regulating trade. It manages critical platforms for interaction between the state and the private sector.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on MGPTT (Algeria)
objects.description: Group Phantom Atlas claimed a "retaliation" leak of social and personal data, publishing beneficiary lists. The MGPTT is a major social institution in Algeria, covering employees in the Postal, Telecommunications, and Information sectors. It manages healthcare reimbursements and social benefits for tens of thousands of civil servants and contractors.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Tawasol (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. Tawasol is a technology solutions integrator based in Cairo that installs security and network infrastructure systems for businesses and smart buildings.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Premier Meats South Africa (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. Premier Meats is a South African company specializing in the processing and distribution of quality meats.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Natilait (Tunisia)
objects.description: Ransomware group cicada3301 claimed attack and leaked data. Natilait is a major player in the Tunisian agrifood sector, specializing in the production and marketing of milk (UHT), yogurt, and derived products.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Royal Moroccan Football Federation (FRMF) (Morocco)
objects.description: Unknown group leaked administrative documents. Founded in 1956, the FRMF is the body responsible for organizing, managing, and developing football in Morocco. It oversees national teams, professional and amateur competitions, as well as regional leagues.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Dar Al Teb (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group gunra claimed attack and leaked data. Dar Al Teb is one of Egypt's most renowned medical centers, specializing in reproductive medicine, in vitro fertilization (IVF), and women's health.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on iOCO (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. EOH is one of South Africa's largest technology service and consulting providers, offering digital transformation and infrastructure solutions. The Devman group used a generic description ("South African IT firm") on its leak site.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on DovesIT (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. DovesIT is a South African Managed Service Provider (MSP). The company offers backup solutions, cloud hosting, network maintenance, and cybersecurity for small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in South Africa.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on South African HR company (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. This is a human resources firm or service provider based in South Africa, managing contractual, payroll, and personal data of numerous employees on behalf of third parties (HR outsourcing).

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Future Association for Microfinance (Egypt)
objects.description: Ransomware group nightspire claimed attack and leaked data. Egyptian NGO specializing in providing microcredit to micro-entrepreneurs and rural populations.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Pienaar Brothers (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. Pienaar Brothers is a South African leader in the supply and distribution of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) and safety solutions for the mining, industrial, and manufacturing sectors.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on South African Airways (SAA) (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group incransom claimed attack and leaked data. South African Airways (SAA) is the national airline and the largest in South Africa, operating domestic and international flights.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on NSSF Kenya (Kenya)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and exfiltrated 2.5 TB of data, with ransom demand of $4.5 million. NSSF is the National Social Security Fund of Kenya. This hack had major repercussions on regional partners in Southern Africa in May 2025.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Medswana (Botswana)
objects.description: Ransomware group killsec claimed attack and leaked data. Medswana (Pty) Ltd is one of Botswana's leading pharmaceutical distributors.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Anglo American plc (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group arkana claimed attack and leaked data. Anglo American plc is a multinational mining company based in Johannesburg and London. It is the world's largest producer of platinum and diamonds, with operations in over 40 countries. It also mines copper, nickel, iron ore, and coal.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on netstar (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group devman claimed attack and leaked data. Netstar, a subsidiary of the Altron group, is the pioneer of the stolen vehicle recovery (SVR) industry in South Africa.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Mediclinic Group (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group everest claimed attack and leaked data. Mediclinic International (Mediclinic Group) is one of the three largest private hospital operators in South Africa. The group manages dozens of multidisciplinary hospitals and day clinics across the country.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on FrontierCo (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group Datacarry claimed attack and leaked data. FrontierCo is a major player in South African distribution. The company holds exclusive distribution licenses and sales rights for several renowned international brands (clothing, footwear, and accessories) through a wide network of physical stores and e-commerce platforms.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on ASCOMA Cameroon (Cameroon)
objects.description: Ransomware group worldleaks claimed attack and leaked data. ASCOMA Cameroon is the Cameroonian branch of the Ascoma group, the leading independent insurance brokerage network in sub-Saharan Africa.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Netmaster (Togo)
objects.description: Unknown group carried out a massive data leak (1 GB). Netmaster is a leading digital service provider in Togo. It acts as the registrar for the national .tg domain and provides web hosting, professional email, and SSL certificate solutions to many Togolese companies and institutions.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on ANCFCC (Morocco)
objects.description: Group NightSpire carried out a massive leak (3.1 GB) of over 10,080 original property certificates. The ANCFCC is the vital body responsible for land registration, cadastre, and cartography in Morocco.
labels: Government / Real Estate and Land Registry

objects.name: Ransomware attack on MTT EXPERTISES (Morocco)
objects.description: Ransomware group incransom claimed attack and leaked data. MTT Expertises is a multidisciplinary engineering and expertise firm based in Casablanca (with offices in Agadir and Tangier).

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Ingonyama Trust Board (South Africa)
objects.description: Ransomware group NightSpire claimed attack and leaked data. The Ingonyama Trust Board (ITB) is a South African administrative authority responsible for managing approximately 2.8 million hectares of communal land in KwaZulu-Natal province.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Best Profil (Morocco)
objects.description: Ransomware group Lynx claimed attack and exfiltrated 26 GB of data, which was published after ransom negotiations failed. Best Profil is one of the leaders in recruitment and temporary work in Morocco.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Crédit Populaire d'Algérie (CPA) (Algeria)
objects.description: Hacktivist group DieNet leaked data samples. CPA is one of the country's main public banks.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Currimjee Jeewanjee & Co (Mauritius)
objects.description: Ransomware group warlock claimed attack and leaked data. Currimjee is one of the oldest and most important conglomerates in Mauritius, operating in telecommunications (Emtel), energy, real estate, tourism, and financial services.

objects.name: Ransomware attack on Banque Nationale d'Algérie (BNA) (Algeria)
objects.description: Group Phantom Atlas carried out a massive data leak: 90 GB exfiltrated, 7 GB published. The Banque Nationale d'Algérie (BNA) is the primary commercial bank of the Algerian state.
